reviews.title: Works great
reviews.body: I bought this for my mom as she lost a part of her old one. The ruler slide smoothly and the measurements written on the ruler are clear and easy to read. It’s the perfect size for most home projects and is very durable and appears to be quality made. I didn’t notice any sharp or rough edges, which is always a concern when purchasing inexpensive tools.

reviews.title: It has a mustache
reviews.body: You know what, it's a combination square. It's great.But the best part and only thing you need to understand is that it comes with a mustache. Not just any mustache, but a distinguished mustache. And a handwritten printed note saying how awesome you are for buying their tool! Now onto the actual review!Mr. Pen combination square has one side dedicated to just inches, 12. And the other side has inches and cm for those who want to use the metric sytem.Accuracy is as good as my tape measure. Measures the same, straight edge. The ruler itself is a straight edge, it might have some burrs on it from the factory though so I'd suggest hitting it with some sandpaper just to soften it up. I personally hit mine with a piece of 80 grit real quick, 1 pass down each side and it's smooth as silk.Ease of use is just that. It's not hard to use at all. To readjust the length of the straight edge, just looked the thumb wheel and slide to where you need it to be, tighten it back up and there you go.The size is a standard 12 inch combo square, you can get smaller ones but this is the normal size for them. It'll still fit in your tool bag and not take up too much space on your tool wall.Well have you ever needed a straight edge but couldn't find your rafter square or L Square? Well this got you. It functions as both of those. It'll give you a 90° angle, 45° angle and I'm sure it can give you other angles as well. I'm personally not using it for that, i have a tool for that already 🤣Well I hope this helped you decide that Mr. Pen is awesome and I'm not being paid to say these things, but they sent me a mustache and I even get a free gift of sorts whenever I decide to sign up for it. So Mr. Pen is great and you should buy their stuff.

reviews.title: Great tool -- Amazing Customer Service (updated 2019-1028)
reviews.body: This is a great addition to a toolkit...I had one that was over 30 years old and well, difficult to read the numbers so a new one was in order.  I spotted this one and decided to purchase it over other brands.  No particular reason except maybe I am partial to mustaches.  I used it for a few hours the other day for marking/measuring lumber for picture frames I was making.  Then, my 4 yr old granddaughter wanted to use it to make lines on some scrap lumber I gave her to play with.  Found out soon enough, the tool is not child proof as she managed to take it apart and loose the spring that holds down the ruler to the handle.  But, all it took was a call to Mr. Pen and Eric said he would put a spring in the mail to me so I can use the tool again.  That's good customer service.Today, in the mail, I thought the spring we lost was in the package from Mr. Pen.  I was totally wrong.  What they sent me was a BRAND NEW COMBINATION SQUARE.  How's that for amazing customer service.  As far as I am concerned, if I am in need of additional products and Mr. Pen has it on their web site, I guarantee I will order it from.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on October 24, 2019
